note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Servers are started hidden by prepare (helper C:\lab\mgnet\svc.ps1) and their logs are shown with Get-Content/Select-String. Azure screens need the owner's az login (labadmin). The App Service host name shows in the live-smoke and restart-empty output: mask it in post (everything except .azurewebsites.net).
prepare: dotnet build src\ProjectRequests.Api\ProjectRequests.Api.csproj -v q --nologo
& $env:MG_SVC ensure -Name ep01-api -Project (Resolve-Path 'src\ProjectRequests.Api').Path -Urls http://localhost:5207 -Port 5207
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login -o none }  # owner signs in (lab subscription, labadmin)

screens.name: local-smoke
prepare: $shim = 'C:\lab\mgnet\bin'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $shim 'zip'))) { [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $shim 'zip'), "#!/bin/bash`n# zip shim (Git Bash has no zip): called as: zip -qr <out.zip> .`n/c/Windows/System32/tar.exe -a -cf `"`$2`" .`n") }; if (-not (Get-Command jq -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { winget install --id jqlang.jq -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements | Out-Null }; $env:PATH = "C:\Program Files\Git\bin;$shim;$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Links;$env:PATH"
if (-not (Test-Path 'src\ProjectRequests.Api\bin\Debug\net10.0\ProjectRequests.Api.dll')) { dotnet build src\ProjectRequests.Api -v q --nologo }
& $env:MG_SVC ensure -Name ep01-api -Project (Resolve-Path 'src\ProjectRequests.Api').Path -Urls http://localhost:5207 -Port 5207

screens.name: openapi
steps: Open the URL in a clean browser window (JSON viewer, everything collapsed)
Show the five status codes: 200, 400, 404, 409 and 503
prepare: & $env:MG_SVC ensure -Name ep01-api -Project (Resolve-Path 'src\ProjectRequests.Api').Path -Urls http://localhost:5207 -Port 5207

screens.name: live-smoke
commands: $h = az webapp show -g rg-mglab-net-01 -n $env:APP --query defaultHostName -o tsv
prepare: $shim = 'C:\lab\mgnet\bin'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $shim 'zip'))) { [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $shim 'zip'), "#!/bin/bash`n# zip shim (Git Bash has no zip): called as: zip -qr <out.zip> .`n/c/Windows/System32/tar.exe -a -cf `"`$2`" .`n") }; if (-not (Get-Command jq -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { winget install --id jqlang.jq -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements | Out-Null }; $env:PATH = "C:\Program Files\Git\bin;$shim;$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Links;$env:PATH"

$env:RG = 'rg-mglab-net-01'; $af = 'C:\lab\mgnet\ep01-app.txt'; if (-not (Test-Path $af)) { "contoso-requests-$(Get-Random -Minimum 1000 -Maximum 9999)" | Set-Content $af }; $env:APP = (Get-Content $af).Trim()
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login -o none }  # owner signs in (lab subscription, labadmin)
mask: app host name in the '==> https://<host>/healthz' line and in the smoke.sh URL, except .azurewebsites.net

screens.name: readonly
steps: Search for the web app (name from C:\lab\mgnet\ep01-app.txt) in the portal search box and open it
Settings > Environment variables > App settings: add (or edit) Api__ReadOnly = true, Apply, confirm the restart
Reveal the value so 'Api__ReadOnly = true' is readable
Beside the browser, in a terminal in the episode folder: $h = az webapp show -g rg-mglab-net-01 -n $env:APP --query defaultHostName -o tsv

Then: curl.exe -i -X POST https://$h/api/requests -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"CRM rollout","budget":75000,"requestedBy":"alex.demo@contoso.com"}'  -> HTTP/1.1 503, Retry-After: 120, 'The API is in read-only mode.'
mask: resource group path and resource ids
signed-in account in the top bar
